subject.title: docs(troubleshooting): add recovery runbook for plugin install metadata conflict after update

question: Should OpenClaw support a deterministic Doctor/plugin-registry repair for conflicting install metadata before the troubleshooting guide instructs users to move the persisted `installs.json` index?
rationale: Current documentation presents that JSON file as durable plugin-install state, while the proposed runbook elevates SQLite and recommends a manual archive without a repository-backed convergence guarantee.

options.title: Require a supported repair path
options.body: Keep the diagnostic guidance, but remove the manual archival instruction until Doctor or the registry command verifies and safely performs the convergence.

options.title: Approve a narrowly defined manual recovery
options.body: Document the archival step only after the plugin-state owner confirms the exact state invariant, supported versions, rollback, and post-recovery checks.

recommendation.title: Require a supported repair path
recommendation.body: Keep the diagnostic guidance, but remove the manual archival instruction until Doctor or the registry command verifies and safely performs the convergence.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision belongs to the current plugin-state and Doctor implementation owner; the available review material did not establish a reliable individual history owner.
